mapper.select: select a.ID,a.`NAME`,a.DEPT_ID,a.DUTY_ID,a.`STATUS`,a.SEX,a.ID_NUMBER, a.BIRTH,a.PHONE,a.HIRE_DATE,a.POSITIVE_TIME,a.USER_ID,a.LEAVE_DATE, c.`NAME` as deptName,d.`NAME` as dutyName from PERSONNEL a left join HR_SALARY_PAY b on a.ID = b.PERSONNEL_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.TYPE = #{type} and b.`YEAR_MONTH` = #{yearMonth} LEFT JOIN SYS_ORG c ON a.DEPT_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_POSITION d ON a.DUTY_ID = d.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS = '0' and a.POSITIVE_TIME is not null and b.ID is null

select a.ID,a.`NAME`,a.DEPT_ID,a.DUTY_ID,a.`STATUS`,a.SEX,a.ID_NUMBER, a.BIRTH,a.PHONE,a.HIRE_DATE,a.POSITIVE_TIME,a.USER_ID,a.LEAVE_DATE, c.`NAME` as deptName,d.`NAME` as dutyName from PERSONNEL a left join HR_SALARY_PAY b on a.ID = b.PERSONNEL_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.TYPE = #{type} and b.ITEM_TYPE = #{itemType} and b.`YEAR_MONTH` = #{yearMonth} LEFT JOIN SYS_ORG c ON a.DEPT_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_POSITION d ON a.DUTY_ID = d.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS = '0' and a.BIRTH is not null and MONTH(a.BIRTH) = #{month} and b.ID is null

select a.ID,a.`NAME`,a.DEPT_ID,a.DUTY_ID,a.`STATUS`,a.SEX,a.ID_NUMBER, a.BIRTH,a.PHONE,a.HIRE_DATE,a.POSITIVE_TIME,a.USER_ID,a.LEAVE_DATE, c.`NAME` as deptName,d.`NAME` as dutyName from PERSONNEL a LEFT JOIN SYS_ORG c ON a.DEPT_ID = c.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_POSITION d ON a.DUTY_ID = d.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.STATUS = '0'
